purpose: Machine-readable plumbing design/checking rules derived from code structure and publicly accessible code information.

rules.condition: A trap is installed without adequate venting/trap-seal protection.
rules.action: Flag the trap and verify vent arrangement and sizing.
rules.source_note: IPC Chapter 9 states venting protects fixture trap seals and maintains an air path.

rules.condition: Vent termination/location does not satisfy the applicable vent-terminal requirements.
rules.action: Check roof/wall termination, clearances and termination height against the applicable section.
rules.source_note: Exact dimensional requirements should be read from the licensed/current code.
